title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 125 South 1st Avenue in Hillsboro, Oregon, as the "Elizabeth Furse Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 125 South 1st Avenue in Hillsboro, Oregon, as the Elizabeth Furse Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Hillsboro, Oregon post office building after former Representative Elizabeth Furse.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 125 South 1st Avenue in Hillsboro, Oregon, as the Elizabeth Furse Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its hours.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
